observations.idea: Grouped action tree (Editor Actions / Main Menu / ...) with a gear for scheme management and a 'Get more keymaps in Settings | Plugins' link; footer OK | Cancel | Apply with Apply disabled when clean.
observations.taomni: Flat filterable action list (text filter) with a scheme select + Copy/Rename/Reset/Delete; footer OK | Cancel | Apply with Apply disabled when the draft is clean.
Copy forks the active scheme into a new editable user scheme without changing any binding.

observations.idea: Modal sub-dialog 'Keyboard Shortcut' with the action's full menu path, a first-stroke field plus '+', an independent 'Second stroke:' checkbox/field, and an always-present warning area.
observations.taomni: Inline recorder docked at the bottom of the Keymap dialog: recorded stroke chips, a live conflict area and OK/Cancel; up to two strokes in one field with Backspace to step back.
Apply is the only commit edge: the draft is written to per-profile localStorage and pushed to the live host; the new chord executes Replace and the old Ctrl+R stops matching.

observations.idea: Inline advisory warning inside the recorder: warning glyph plus 'Already assigned to:' listing every holder with its menu path, scrollable; OK stays enabled; Cancel discards with no change.
observations.taomni: Inline advisory warning inside the recorder: warning glyph plus 'Already assigned to:' listing every holder as 'Title (action-id)' in a scrollable area; OK stays enabled; Cancel discards the capture, the draft and live binding are unchanged and Ctrl+F still runs Find.
Confirming the contested chord and applying leaves exactly one owner: editor.replace keeps Ctrl+F, editor.find visibly loses it, and the live dispatcher runs Replace on Ctrl+F.

observations.idea: Settings Cancel closes the dialog and returns to the baseline; no keymap file is written.
observations.taomni: Cancel / Esc / overlay / X all discard the draft: the live effective binding and the stored bytes are unchanged and the previously applied chord still runs.
Reset restores base inheritance and applies; Delete removes the user scheme, the select returns to the default entry, and editing is possible again.

deltas.ideaValue: grouped action tree with per-group headers and a scheme gear
deltas.taomniValue: flat list with a text filter and a scheme select
deltas.explanation: IDEA groups actions and offers scheme management through a gear. Taomni keeps a single filterable list; the group hierarchy is not modelled.
deltas.disposition: accepted-difference: the grouped tree is a wider capability than this card's rebind/conflict/cancel/apply sequence; not built.

deltas.ideaValue: modal sub-dialog with an independent 'Second stroke' field
deltas.taomniValue: inline recorder with up to two strokes in one field
deltas.explanation: IDEA makes the second chord stroke a separate first-class field; Taomni records both strokes in one capture and uses Backspace to step back.
deltas.disposition: accepted-difference: functionally equivalent for one- and two-stroke chords; a second independent field was not built.

deltas.ideaValue: holder action plus its menu path, e.g. 'in Plugins | Markdown'
deltas.taomniValue: holder title plus its action id, e.g. 'Find in File (editor.find)'
deltas.explanation: Taomni's action catalog has no menu-path hierarchy, so the id carries the locating role the menu path plays in IDEA.
deltas.disposition: accepted-difference: structural, follows from the action model rather than from the conflict logic.

deltas.ideaValue: multiple right-aligned keycap chips per binding, multiple bindings joined by 'or', empty when unbound
deltas.taomniValue: one monospace pill per binding, 'no shortcut' when unbound
deltas.explanation: IDEA renders Ctrl and R as separate keycaps and right-aligns them; Taomni renders a single pill adjacent to the title and shows an explicit placeholder.
deltas.disposition: accepted-difference: recorded as a presentation gap; the card's functional contract of which chord owns what is unaffected.

deltas.taomniValue: observed: one owner per chord, previous holder visibly loses it

verdict.reason: The 2026-09-24 IDEA sampling was protection-first (Cancel only), so S1/S3/S4b/S8 were never run on the IDEA side and the two-sided comparison is incomplete; compare_idea.py therefore computes 'unverified' rather than 'different' or 'matched'. Within the steps that WERE observed on both sides, the functional conflict/cancel contract (S4a) and the no-persistence-on-cancel contract (S5) match, while the Keymap page and recorder presentations genuinely differ (flat filtered list vs grouped tree; inline recorder vs modal sub-dialog; single pill vs keycap chips) and are recorded in deltas. The Taomni side of every step, including the unobserved IDEA ones, is proven by TC-IDE-C1-01, TC-IDE-PARITY-004-01..04 and the unit suite.

ceiling.capability: Keymap rebind to conflict warning to cancel/apply to reopen for a single existing action, plus the retained reset/delete/input-protection behaviour
